jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs & Market Development
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

In this role, you will help accelerate the adoption of utility EV managed charging and virtual power plant programs by shaping the regulatory, policy, and market conditions that enable WeaveGrid’s growth.

The ideal candidate is a hybrid policy strategist and market builder: someone who can shape markets externally, build coalitions, manage consultants, brief internal teams, and turn regulatory developments into commercial insight. You will work closely with Business Development, ClientSuccess, Product, Marketing, Legal, and executive leadership to ensure WeaveGrid is positioned to win in priority markets and help utilities unlock the full grid value of EVs and other distributed energy resources.

Responsibilities

Primary responsibilities include:

Regulatory Strategy & Market Development

  • Develop and execute WeaveGrid’s regulatory and policy engagement strategy across priority North American markets.

  • Identify, monitor, and prioritize high-leverage regulatory proceedings, legislative developments, utility planning processes, and market design initiatives relevant to transportation electrification, managed charging, VPPs, DER flexibility, rate design, distribution planning, DSM, and grid modernization.

  • Translate regulatory and policy developments into actionable recommendations for WeaveGrid’s commercial strategy, client engagement, product roadmap, and market prioritization.

  • Support market entry and expansion strategies by identifying policy tailwinds, regulatory barriers, utility program opportunities, and potential coalition partners.

  • Support utility program approvals and expansions by helping clients and internal teams navigate regulatory processes.

  • Identify new business models, program designs, and partnership opportunities emerging from federal, state, and utility-level policy initiatives.

Regulatory Engagement, Advocacy & Thought Leadership

  • Draft, review, and coordinate regulatory comments, testimony, white papers, policy briefs, and other advocacy materials.

  • Represent WeaveGrid in regulatory proceedings, stakeholder workshops, industry convenings, and trade associations while building relationships with regulators, policymakers, utilities, advocates, NGOs, and other stakeholders.

  • Partner with Marketing to create thought leadership materials, conference content, case studies, and other public-facing narratives that strengthen WeaveGrid’s market position.

Coalition Building & Consultant Management

  • Identify opportunities for WeaveGrid to work through coalitions, trade associations, industry groups, and aligned partners to advance shared policy objectives.

  • Cultivate and manage outside consultants, attorneys, lobbyists, and policy advisors to support market monitoring, regulatory filings, stakeholder engagement, and advocacy strategy.

Internal Intelligence & Cross-Functional Enablement

  • Serve as WeaveGrid’s internal expert on regulatory and policy developments affecting priority markets, customers, and commercial opportunities.

  • Brief Business Development, Client Success, Product, Marketing, Legal, and executive stakeholders on relevant policy developments, market signals, and implications for WeaveGrid.

  • Create repeatable internal processes for tracking proceedings, summarizing developments, flagging risks and opportunities, and enabling commercial teams to act on regulatory intelligence.

  • Partner with Business Development teams to support RFPs, proposals, bid defenses, customer conversations, account plan updates, and new market development.

  • Partner with Client Success teams to support existing utility clients navigating regulatory approvals, filings, program design changes, evaluation requirements, or stakeholder engagement.

  • Partner with Product and Solutions teams to ensure regulatory trends, utility planning needs, and market requirements inform product strategy and roadmap decisions.

About You

  • You are a strategic policy and market development leader who understands how regulatory decisions shape commercial opportunities.

  • You are comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting strategy, writing comments, managing consultants, briefing executives, supporting customer conversations, and building external relationships.

  • You have strong judgment about where to engage, when to influence directly, when to work through coalitions, and how to focus limited startup resources on the highest-leverage opportunities.

  • You are an excellent communicator who can translate complex regulatory, technical, and market developments into clear implications for commercial, product, and executive audiences.

  • You are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of transportation electrification, grid flexibility, managed charging, and virtual power plants.

  • You embrace WeaveGrid’s organizational values of Accountability, Collaboration, Focus, Urgency, Empathy, and Learning.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of full-time experience in some combination of energy policy, utility regulation, market development, public affairs, clean energy advocacy, regulatory strategy, management consulting, utility programs, or related fields.

  • Strong understanding of electric utility regulation and one or more of the following areas: transportation electrification, distributed energy resources, demand response, DSM, VPPs, rate design, grid modernization, distribution planning, IRPs, Distribution System Plans, or utility program design.

  • Track record of achieving policy outcomes by engaging with public utility commissions, state energy offices, political leaders, utilities, trade associations, consumer advocates, NGOs, or other energy policy stakeholders, with the judgment and credibility to represent a company externally.

  • Excellent writing skills, including experience drafting or contributing to regulatory comments, policy briefs, testimony, white papers, public presentations, or executive briefings.

  • Ability to translate policy and regulatory developments into actionable insights for commercial, customer success, product, and executive teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple proceedings, markets, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously with limited supervision.

  • Experience managing outside consultants, attorneys, advisors, coalitions, or trade association engagement.

  • Based in the United States and willing to travel periodically for customer meetings, regulatory convenings, conferences, and internal team events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in transportation electrification, EV managed charging, DERMS, VPPs, demand flexibility, utility program design, or grid-edge software.

  • Experience supporting utility program approvals, rate cases, IRPs, distribution system planning, DSM filings, transportation electrification plans, or VPP/demand flexibility proceedings.

  • Established network in the energy regulatory, utility, transportation electrification, or DER policy community.

  • Advanced degree in public policy, law, business, energy systems, engineering, or a related field preferred.

Compensation

The total compensation for this opportunity includes a base salary range of $138,600 - 198,000 plus equity and benefits.

This is our target compensation range and is subject to multiple factors including role, level, experience, and location. Please note that WeaveGrid may not necessarily hire individuals at or near the top of the base salary range. As you go through our interview process, our recruiter will work with you to identify a competitive base salary within the proposed range and combine it with an equity package to get you excited about your future at WeaveGrid.

San Francisco Bay Area preferred, remote considered.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Our software solves the most critical emerging grid integration challenges to ensure that the impending energy transition is clean, equitable, and resilient. Our enterprise solutions help the grid absorb the coming electrification wave with ease. Utilizing modern, cloud-native platform architecture and robust systems optimization, WeaveGrid’s software is built from the ground up to tackle the most critical network challenges while meeting the stringent regulatory, security, and reliability requirements of the utility industry.

About the role

As a Senior Product Manager, you will drive the product strategy and execution for the software applications, platform, and integrations that enable our clients and partners to launch, manage, and scale VPP Programs of DERs. You will work directly with a variety of business and technical stakeholders from clients, partners, consumers, and internal teams to define the roadmap for the core enterprise platform. This role is hands-on, leading core enterprise SaaS product management activities from strategic planning and detailed feature scoping to backlog prioritization and GTM enablement.

Core Responsibilities

Tasks include, but are not limited to:

  • Execution & Delivery: drive major portions of the product roadmap for enterprise platform and operational use cases

    • Collect and analyze qualitative and quantitative data to determine product direction and define business requirements, including KPIs and OKRs

    • Translate complex work into clear written artifacts (short decision memos, weekly updates, slides, stakeholder readouts) that unblock teams and drive alignment

    • Define, design, and deliver product features, including seamless integrations with adjacent products and services

    • Maintain groomed backlog and roadmap in Jira

    • Work with agile scrum teams on design, definition, documentation and implementation of features for new applications

    • Coordinate and participate in user acceptance testing of functional requirements

  • Market Enablement: Serve as the internal and external subject matter expert for product offerings, working with Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Client Success groups

    • Support Client Facing Demonstrations of the product

    • Conduct research to identify customer needs and market gaps

    • Support strategic initiatives and other duties as needed to ensure product success

    • Support operations and engineering teams as required

  • Other duties as assigned

About you

You are an outcome-obsessed and data-driven product leader who excels at turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable roadmaps, PRDs, and tickets. You are structured and methodical, skillfully balancing the needs of multiple enterprise clients, partners, users, and internal teams to keep our product development focused and enabled. As a natural collaborator, you're looking to join a team where you can apply your talents to a mission you care about: accelerating the transition to a clean, electrified future.

  • 5+ years of experience in product management; with focus on complex, data-intensive products for enterprise

  • Advanced user of Jira, Figma, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, Claude, Slack

  • Comfort with APIs, multi-modal user interfaces, technical documentation

  • Ability to manage a wide breadth of projects and priorities simultaneously

  • Clear and succinct communication practices - verbally and in writing

  • Passiong for diving into emerging technologies and industries

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with B2B2C products and multi-sided markets

  • Experience with IoT, DERs, electric utilities, power markets, or related industry

  • Experience with SQL, data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar) and building/maintaining a data warehouse and platform infrastructure

  • Previous success in a start-up

San Francisco Bay Area (preferred) or Remote

The total compensation for this opportunity includes a base salary range of $130,000 - $200,000 plus equity (stock options) and benefits. This is our target compensation range and is subject to multiple factors including role, level, experience, and location. Please note that WeaveGrid may not necessarily hire individuals at or near the top of the base salary range. As you go through our interview process, our recruiter and hiring manager will work with you to identify a competitive base salary within the proposed range and combine it with an equity package to get you excited about your future at WeaveGrid.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Our software solves the most critical emerging grid integration challenges to ensure that the impending energy transition is clean, equitable, and resilient. Our enterprise solutions help the grid absorb the coming electrification wave with ease. Utilizing modern, cloud-native platform architecture and robust systems optimization, WeaveGrid’s software is built from the ground up to tackle the most critical network challenges while meeting the stringent regulatory, security, and reliability requirements of the utility industry.

About the job

WeaveGrid's clean energy SaaS products monitor and manage a growing portfolio of distributed energy resources, including electric vehicles and battery energy storage systems, on behalf of electric utilities. We are seeking a seasoned backend engineer to independently design, implement, and deploy software with our partner device manufacturers and utilities. In this role, you will contribute to the technical direction of the team and help raise the bar for engineering quality. The impact of your code will be broad, from deeply integrating with diverse device manufacturer APIs, to monitoring and understanding battery status, to scheduling and verifying optimal charge or discharge plans, to ingesting, aggregating, and integrating signals from various utility sources.

In this role, we will ask you to:

  • Design and produce high quality code for robustness, testability, and maintainability

  • Work with our Python backend, relational database schemas, and microservice architecture & develop deep ownership of your area of work, including its long-term health, reliability, and technical debt

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and business stakeholders to design and deliver new, scalable product features that expand our platform’s DERMS capabilities.

  • Collaborate with engineers to improve system reliability, data quality, effectiveness, and scalability across our product and codebase.

  • Own rollouts, instrumentation, alerting, and reliability monitoring in our production cloud environment

  • Create brand new capabilities with new partners while reusing and generalizing existing modules

  • Use Docker containers, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub, Jira/Confluence, and CircleCI

  • Participate in on-call rotations, periodically (~once per quarter) serving as the frontline presence for monitoring, diagnosing, and triaging production service issues

  • Contribute to the growth of the team through mentorship, design reviews, and code reviews, and serve as an effective interviewer for engineering candidates

  • Coordinate with multiple teams across several codebases in the engineering organization

  • Contribute to team prioritization by identifying and proposing improvements to your area of work, including new capabilities, reliability investments, and technical debt reduction

  • Special projects and other duties as designated by your manager or assigned designee

About you

  • You are driven to use your skills and talents to help fix the climate crisis

  • You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering complex backend systems independently

  • If working remotely, you are available to collaborate with team members during standard US West Coast working hours

  • If you’re based in the San Francisco Bay Area, you will be working from our San Francisco office 2 days/week

  • You care about the craft of software and feel a sense of ownership about code

  • You leverage AI tools effectively in your workflow, including for coding, while maintaining the engineering judgment to critically evaluate and catch AI-generated errors or subtle incorrectness

  • You enjoy solving hard technical problems and are excited to tackle the complexity of software that interacts with the real world

  • You think in systems, independently scoping and delivering end-to-end projects with an understanding of how your work fits into the broader architecture - and you proactively surface and resolve ambiguity rather than waiting for it to be clarified

  • You are proficient in a language like Go or Python and have expertise building microservices in a cloud-based backend

  • You enjoy being hands-on in the full lifecycle of software development: early design, testing, production deployment, post-launch iteration, measuring and monitoring outcomes, and quickly fixing problems that may arise

  • You thrive in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment, where priorities frequently shift to meet changing business needs and you help others navigate that ambiguity effectively

The total compensation for this opportunity includes a base salary range of $130,000 - $190,000 plus equity (stock options) and benefits. This is our target compensation range and is subject to multiple factors including role, level, experience, and location. Please note that WeaveGrid may not necessarily hire individuals at or near the top of the base salary range. As you go through our interview process, our recruiter will work with you to identify a competitive base salary within the proposed range and combine it with an equity package to get you excited about your future at WeaveGrid.
